# Kalos

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Kalos has 30 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from X and Y (both versions).

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges.

#### Gym 1: Viola (Santalune) -- the Bug Badge
Bug specialist. 2 Pokemon, best level 12: your team fights at level 12 at most, and on hard you bring 2 at most. Prize money: $600 on easy, $1,200 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surskit | Bug/Water | 10 | Water Gun, Bubble, Quick Attack |
| Vivillon | Bug/Flying | 12 | Struggle Bug, Gust |

**Hit them with** Rock, Flying, Electric moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Water, Flying, Bug. **Careful with** Grass Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Catchable before this fight:** Masquerain (ROUTE 3), Farfetchd (ROUTE 22), Pikachu (ROUTE 3), Fletchling (ROUTE 3).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).

#### Elite Four, seat 1: Malva
Fire specialist. 4 Pokemon, best level 65: your team fights at level 65 at most, and on hard you bring 4 at most. Prize money: $3,250 on easy, $6,500 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|

| Chandelure | Ghost/Fire | 63 | Overheat, Inferno, Shadow Ball, Ember |

**Hit them with** Rock, Water, Ground moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Fire, Flying, Ghost. **Careful with** Grass, Bug Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard.
